verdict.rationale: Raygun documents filtering and segmenting errors by custom tags and prioritizing by users affected, which implies tags and user identity can be attached to error events. It also automatically captures stack traces with environment details such as OS, browser, host and version, and the SDK can filter data before sending. There is no evidence of breadcrumbs or of an SDK API for attaching user context to every event. Missing for 10: breadcrumb support, a documented SDK API for setting tags and user context per event, independent or hands-on corroboration.
